blindDescriptions.System A: visionOS 26 Accessibility (Settings > Accessibility > Display & Text Size / Motion / Audio): Centered true glass over live passthrough world (saturate1.6 blur28-34 + rim light + feathered 40/90 shadow, not synthetic radial). Single header 'Accessibility' 22/800 -0.03 + 11/600 'Display & Text Size · tabular' single line, preview paragraph live at top reflows entire UI as you scrub Dynamic Type slider (7 steps 80%-310% UIContentSizeCategory, not preview-only) with Bold Text toggle, Increase Contrast (removes transparency -> 0.92 opaque + 1.5px stroke vs ours 0.26), Reduce Motion (converts all springs to 160ms crossfade interruptible system-wide, respects prefers-reduced-motion out of box), Reduce Transparency, Color Filters with shape+text alternatives. Each card isolates one control + live preview, one focal element dim others to 0.38, focus ring 2.5px #56b8ff halo 3px bloom 22px scale1.02 parallax unmistakable idle. Motion 260ms prism-ease interruptible spring everywhere, no infinite loops. Typography 3 sizes max per card (22/14/11) SF Pro -0.015 tracking, tabular only on time/size. No dev chrome, no hintbar clutter. Edge states native sheets with single illustration + one CTA. Delight is the live Dynamic Type preview itself — earned, functional, glass vibrancy.
blindDescriptions.System B: Horizon OS Accessibility v74 (Settings > Accessibility on Quest 3): Flat opaque charcoal panel #232323 16r 1px #2f2f2f border shadow8 no backdrop-filter. Header 16/700 'Accessibility' + list of 6 toggles full-width: Text Size slider 100-200 coarse snap 25, High Contrast (inverts grey to white harsh, no glass), Reduce Motion (cuts to instant, not eased), Mono Audio, Color Correction presets. Preview is static text box 'The quick brown fox' not live metrics/wave, no pulse. Groups crammed vertical no preview-card isolation, icon 24 flat tint grey, title14 medium body12 regular weak hierarchy 5 sizes mixed, no tabular outside time. Focus ring 1px blue competing across 6 equal rows, no gaze halo, dwell not advertised. Scroll required (800px list) hintbar 'Swipe to dismiss' flat. Motion linear 350-450ms slide with bounce, not interruptible. Edge: empty 'No settings' text, loading spinner 'Loading...' centered, error red text 'Failed to load' flat Retry, offline snackbar overlapping list, permission system dialog opaque. No undo queue, no glass, no signature moment beyond flat toggle.

biggestGap: Accessibility — text scale is preview-only, not system-wide (VISION 8): expected visionOS Dynamic Type where --a11y-scale reflows entire UI (7 stops 80-310% + Bold, slider scrubs all type + preview live, tabular retained). Got components/13-a11y/index.html:14 --a11y-scale:1.25 + :553 range 100-150 step25 + :525 chips 100/125/150 + :231 kicker calc(10px*var(--scale)) title calc(18px*var--) body calc(13px*var--) caption calc(11px*var--) inside #previewStage only — verified after setting range to 150: stage --a11y-scale 1.5 preview-kicker 15px title27px ok but row-title computed 14px row-sub 11px scale-chip 11px group-label 11px remain fixed (evaluate distinctSizesStage 8 vs distinctCard 6). Whole viewport does not scale, glanceability still requires 2-3 swipes (scrollHeight1519 vs556) to reach equivalence grid. Slider offers only 3 coarse stops vs visionOS 7. Contrast toggle only outline 0.12->0.26 and ink-60 0.66->0.78 not transparency removal (stage bg stays 0.76). Mono only icon+wave muted no haptics. Criterion scores 5 vs visionOS 9 and ties horizon 5 — fatal on the accessibility piece itself. Fix: apply --a11y-scale to viewport root (clamp fluid body 14->21 at 150%, caption 11->16) or remap all type via calc, keep preview live but scrub whole list, add 4 intermediate stops 110/125/135/150, wire high-contrast to reduce blur22->12 and mat-glass opacity 0.78->0.92 as visionOS Increase Contrast does.
